description: Spike before any cascade build (PLAN section 5, phase 3.2): can the shadow pass be isolated and drawn once per cascade with its own light matrix (proxy replay of the pass's draws, or calling the engine's pass again through a hook), with the receiving shaders replaced to pick and sample the right cascade? A two-cascade prototype in the 40-unit battle with its cost, and why blob shadows are drawn and whether cascades remove them. Kill: pass not isolable, or cost over the J23 budget: stop and report; the fallback is J24. Output: go or no-go and a design for J26.
title: Cascaded shadows spike
